## Summary

The second real connector on the P04.1 eight-stage framework (§23.3), of
deliberately different shape from `osm`: agency-level **adoption** from the EFF
Atlas of Surveillance. It writes a single predicate — `deployment_exists` — at
**family-level** technology granularity into the CC-BY-4.0 SIG graph compartment,
keys on the Atlas agency identifier, routes non-ORI-shaped values to the surrogate
identity path (feeding P03.2's crosswalk) without ever resolving entities itself,
and records a retired Atlas category as a **retirement, not a world change**.

Implements `docs/tickets/P04.3__atlas-connector.md` (spec §23.3, SIG-ONTO-059).
Stacked on `devin/p04-2-osm-connector`.

## What changed

- **`connectors/src/connectors/atlas.py`** — the `AtlasConnector` (eight stages) +
  pure helpers: `agency_identity` routing, `category_mapping`,
  `assert_predicate_allowed`, evidence-genre normalization, `category_retirement_record`,
  `canary_findings`, `parse_csv`.
- **`connectors/src/connectors/data/atlas_vocab.toml`** — versioned data: category→family
  map (seeded from the `eff_atlas` crosswalk), the nine methodology genres, the
  predicate allowlist, and the retired-category ledger.
- **`connectors/src/connectors/__init__.py`** — imports `atlas` so it self-registers (SIG-INGEST-021).
- **Tests** — `tests/connectors/test_atlas.py` (24 tests), a CLI listing test,
  committed CSV fixtures under `tests/connectors/fixtures/atlas/`.
- **Docs** — `ADR-028`, and P04.3 sections in `docs/traceability.md` and `docs/risk_register.md`.

## Design decisions

- **Family granularity, not technology** — §23.3 mandates family level; the crosswalk to
  the finer concept is `broadMatch`/`relatedMatch` + `lossy`, so writing the fine concept
  would fabricate precision (SIG-STORE-040). The SKOS relation + lossy flag ride on every row.
- **Connector emits candidate identifiers, never resolves** (SIG-INGEST-034) — ORI-shaped →
  `us.fbi.ori`, else the `atlas.agency_name` surrogate path; `link()` stays the identity default.
- **Category retirement is keyed on the Atlas version, not wall-clock time**, so it can be
  emitted inside the pure `normalize` stage without breaking replay idempotency (SIG-INGEST-003).
- **Realised at the connector layer** (compartment stamping + export gate) because connectors
  are not DB-wired yet — same posture as ADR-027 (`osm`).

## Verification

- `make`-equivalent gate all green: `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `mypy` (99 source files),
  full `pytest` (861 passed), and `verify-gen` (no diff to `pylock.toml`/`ontology/generated`).
- 104 connector tests pass (24 new for `atlas`).
- Drove the connector end-to-end over the committed fixture: 5 `deployment_exists` claims
  (family granularity, CC-BY-4.0/`sig_graph`, surrogate + ORI routes), 1 unmapped-category
  research task, 1 `atlas_category_retired` vocabulary event (Ring/Neighbors, 2024-03, 2530
  removed data points); CLI lists `atlas` and gates the seed row REFUSED (SIG-INGEST-028).

## Acceptance criteria → evidence

| AC (§23.3) | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Rows preserve Atlas source attribution + recorded vocabulary version | `atlas._stamp`/`atlas_version`; `test_rows_preserve_atlas_source_attribution_and_vocabulary_version` |
| Retired category recorded as a category retirement, not a world change (SIG-ONTO-059) | `category_retirement_record` (`atlas_category_retired` vocabulary event, ≠ `deployment_ended`); `test_retired_category_is_recorded_as_a_category_retirement` |
| Keys on the Atlas agency identifier; non-ORI-shaped → surrogate path (SIG-INGEST-034) | `agency_identity`; `test_ori_shaped_agency_routes_to_the_canonical_path`, `test_non_ori_shaped_agency_routes_to_the_surrogate_path`, `test_agency_routing_flows_through_the_pipeline`, `test_connector_does_not_resolve_entities_itself` |
| Writes confined to `deployment_exists` at family granularity; counts/coords/config/status refused (SIG-INGEST-033) | `assert_predicate_allowed`/`predicate_allowlist`; `test_only_deployment_exists_is_written_at_family_granularity`, `test_predicate_allowlist_refuses_counts_coordinates_config_status` |
| Producing methodology component carried where recorded, else granularity loss (no guessed tier) | `AtlasConnector._resolve_genre`; `test_genre_is_a_granularity_loss_when_the_feed_records_no_component`, `test_genre_is_carried_when_the_feed_records_the_component` |
| Committed fixtures + a canary | `tests/connectors/fixtures/atlas/*.csv`, `canary_findings`; `test_canary_passes_on_the_committed_fixture`, `test_canary_flags_structural_drift` |
| Phase-gate (§51.3): CI green, automated tests, ADR, traceability + risk register | 861 passed; ADR-028; `docs/traceability.md` + `docs/risk_register.md` P04.3 sections |
